description: This file contains an abstract test class 'CopierTester' in the namespace 'Orleans.Serialization.TestKit', which provides a framework for testing deep copying (cloning) capabilities for generic types using Orleans serialization mechanisms. It includes test methods for verifying copying correctness, reference handling, and serialization of collections and tuples. The class is designed to be extended with specific type and copier implementations.

classes.name: CopierTester
classes.description: An abstract generic test class for verifying deep copy functionality of types with Orleans serializers. It defines test methods for equality, reference handling, serialization, and collection copying, meant to be extended with specific types and copiers.
